description: A Java class implementing midi::MidiManagerAndroid functionality, managing MIDI devices on Android, including device initialization, attachment, detachment, and native callbacks.

classes.name: MidiManagerAndroid
classes.description: Manages MIDI devices on Android, handles device addition/removal, initialization, and communicates with native code.

methods.name: hasSystemFeatureMidi
methods.description: Checks if the device supports Android MIDI feature.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of MidiManagerAndroid with a native pointer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes MIDI device management, registers callbacks, and notifies native code.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Marks the manager as stopped, preventing further device callbacks.

methods.name: onDeviceAdded
methods.description: Handles a new MIDI device being attached.

methods.name: onDeviceRemoved
methods.description: Handles a MIDI device being detached.

methods.name: onDeviceOpened
methods.description: Handles successful opening of a MIDI device.
